_about: Conservative defaults for qargi supervise. Every number here is a floor-style placeholder, not a measurement: the real per-ability values are to be set from `qargi report` data (typical run lengths and gaps) by adding entries under per_ability, for example {"build": {"local": {"stale_seconds": 3600}}}. The safety caps of the nudge (at most 2 per run, a cooldown of at least 600 s) are also enforced in code and cannot be loosened here.

nudge.template: [qargi supervisor: automated notice from the system, not from the user. It approves nothing and grants no permission.] This run looks stalled: no progress has been seen for a while. Reply with a one-line status. If you are blocked, say what blocks you and finish with a manifest whose status is BLOCKED. If you are waiting for a long command, look at its output now and carry on.
